topics.description: Multiple election fraud investigations are underway across the US, with a focus on California and other states. These investigations involve allegations of voter fraud, campaign finance irregularities, and other election-related crimes.

Pennsylvania leads the nation in Medicaid fraud convictions, with a strong focus on investigating and prosecuting healthcare providers who commit fraud. This trend highlights the importance of monitoring and regulating Medicaid programs.
topics.reason: High number of convictions in Pennsylvania
